message: `@(... {event} ...)`, an event trigger this engine does not schedule
description: A trigger naming `{event}` is honoured only as an `or` list of `cross(...)`, `above(...)`, `timer(...)`, `initial_step` and `final_step`. Discarding it would run the body at every solve point instead of when the event fires: a wrong answer rather than a missing feature.
actions: Write the trigger with those events only; `absdelta` is not implemented.
